cli.mcp.launchPrompt: Start this MCP server to read its tools? [y/N]
cli.mcp.toolsPrompt: Trust this MCP server and pin these tools? [y/N]
cli.mcp.grant.granted: Policy grant written: this server is yours to call (standart asks every call; full-auto runs it, audited).
cli.mcp.grant.revoked: Policy grant removed: calls to this server follow your company policy again.
cli.mcp.grant.refused: Trusted, but no policy grant was written: {reason}.
models.notConfigured: Model catalog is not configured; availability was not observed.
models.availabilityNotObserved: Declarations only; availability was not observed.
models.bindingNotDeclared: {reference}: exact model version is not declared in catalog {revision}.
models.bindingDeclared:
{reference} | catalog {revision} | native ID {nativeId} | SHA-256 {digest}

models.catalog.heading: Model catalog as scope {scope} sees it: {count} channel(s)
models.catalog.channel: Channel {channel} ({kind}, CLI {cli}) · revision {revision} · catalog {catalog} · {state} in this scope
models.catalog.channelDenied: Channel {channel}: not visible (no model-activation inspect grant)
models.catalog.model: - {model} · lifecycle {lifecycle} (retire {retire}) · CLI ≥ {cli} · efforts {efforts} · vendor {vendor} · canonical {canonical} · billing {billing} · context {context} · aliases (refused) {aliases} · {state}
models.catalog.receipt: {replay}: command {command} ({action}) in scope {scope}, authority level {level}; changes: {changes}
models.catalog.noChanges: none (the catalog already held these facts)
models.catalog.notice: Catalog facts and activation decide which exact models new worker Runs may use; they do not prove the provider serves the model.
models.activation.absent: {reference} in scope {scope}: no persisted activation record; not activated.
models.activation.persisted: {reference} in scope {scope}: persisted {state} activation at revision {revision}.
models.activation.receipt: {replay}: command {command} recorded {state} activation for {reference} in scope {scope} at revision {revision}.
models.activation.notice: Recorded activation only; provider availability and invocation permission are not established.
models.invocation.responded: native response content retained separately from the receipt
models.invocation.respondedPurged: native response received; response content has been purged
models.invocation.rejected: rejection content retained separately from the receipt; counts toward the total call quota
models.invocation.rejectedPurged: rejection received; response content has been purged; counts toward the total call quota
models.invocation.unknownPurged: outcome unknown; response content has been purged
models.invocation.notSent: never sent; cancellation {command} prevented dispatch before permission
models.invocation.replayed: Existing receipt returned; request was not sent again.
models.invocation.purgeNotice: Logical purge does not erase write-ahead logs, media, or backups.
models.invocation.noticePurged: A received native response or rejection is evidence only; it is neither task acceptance nor a billing determination. This invocation counts toward the total call quota; retry the same command identity to return its receipt without resending. Response content has been logically purged; human output never shows response content.
models.invocation.notice: A received native response or rejection is evidence only; it is neither task acceptance nor a billing determination. This invocation counts toward the total call quota; retry the same command identity to return its receipt without resending. Response content, if captured, is retained separately from the receipt and withheld by default. JSON includeResponseContent additionally requires inspect-content permission; human output never shows retained response content.
models.invocation.noticeNotSent: No provider request was sent. This admitted invocation still counts toward the local total call quota; its in-flight slot has been released. Retry the same command identity to return this receipt without sending a new request.
models.invocation.cancellationPrevented: Cancellation {command}: prevented before sending. Requested by {actor}.
models.invocation.cancellationRequested: Cancellation {command}: requested; provider stop is unconfirmed. Requested by {actor}.
models.invocation.cancellationAlreadyTer: Cancellation {command}: the invocation outcome was already recorded when cancellation was requested. Requested by {actor}.
models.invocation.cancellationNotice: This records local cancellation intent. After send permission, it does not prove that a provider received, stopped, or completed work.
models.invocation.spendingAbsent: No recorded monetary evidence for this invocation. This does not mean it was free or zero cost.
models.invocation.spendingReserved: Local reservation: up to {maximum} minor units ({currency}), using recorded tariff {tariffId} v{tariffVersion}. This is not a provider invoice.
models.invocation.spendingHeld: Local reservation held: up to {maximum} minor units ({currency}), using recorded tariff {tariffId} v{tariffVersion}; reason: {reason}. This is not a provider invoice.
models.invocation.spendingReleasedNotSen: Local reservation released before sending: up to {maximum} minor units ({currency}), using recorded tariff {tariffId} v{tariffVersion}. This is not a provider invoice.
models.invocation.spendingSettledLocal: Local calculated amount: {amount} minor units ({currency}) (quoted maximum: {maximum} minor units ({currency})) using recorded tariff {tariffId} v{tariffVersion}. This is not a provider invoice.
models.invocation.spendingSettledProvide: Provider-reported charge: exact {exactAmount} minor units ({currency}); local per-invocation rounding projection: {roundedAmount} minor units ({currency}) (quoted maximum: {maximum} minor units ({currency})). This is provider-reported usage, not a local tariff calculation or external invoice verification.
models.invocation.spendingReason.overrun: local amount exceeded the quote maximum
models.invocation.historyIntegrityNotRec: No persisted full-history audit result is available; this view validates the queried records.
